name: EVOSST
title: Evaluation and Valorization of Social Services for a Sustainable Transition
institution: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest
funding: Horizon Europe · Research and Innovation Action
summary: Predictive modelling and data analysis to understand the long-term impact of social services.
description: EVOSST develops life-course assessment models for healthcare, childcare, long-term care, education and social inclusion. The consortium combines well-being measures and digital technologies to support more effective, evidence-informed social policies.
contributions: Collecting and processing datasets relevant to social-service impact assessment.
Developing predictive models for the long-term effects of services in healthcare, education and social inclusion.
Visualising results to support interpretation and their use in public-policy development.
details: Coordinator: University of Western Macedonia, Greece.

name: Renewable district heating
title: Feasibility study for the integration of solar and wind energy into district heating systems using advanced heat storage solutions
funding: EEA Grants 2014–2021 and Norway Grants 2014–2021 · Bilateral Cooperation for the Green Transition
summary: Assessing renewable heat production and advanced thermal storage for district heating.
description: A feasibility study of the integration of solar and wind energy into district heating, with an emphasis on advanced heat-storage solutions and the selection of suitable technologies.
contributions: Analysed Best Available Technology (BAT) for integrating renewable sources into thermal-energy production.
Assessed optimal heat-storage solutions for the proposed district-heating integration.
details: Funding countries: Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway.

name: SMARTELTER
title: Green Mobile Services for Smart City Energy Supply
funding: Competitiveness Operational Programme (POC) · Action 1.2.1 · Innovative Technological Project
summary: Research and innovation for mobile green energy services in the smart city.
description: SMARTELTER addresses mobile green electricity-supply services for smart cities. Its programme supports business-led R&D, individually or in partnership with research institutes and universities, to advance product and process innovation in sectors with growth potential.
contributions: Directed the project's research and management activities.
Led work within the Innovative Technological Project funding framework.

name: Resilient nanogrids
title: Resilient and Self-Recovering Nano Electric Networks
funding: National Plan PN III (2013–2020) · Horizon 2020 Participation Award
summary: National support for participation in European research on resilient, self-recovering electrical nanogrids.
description: A competitively awarded national project supporting Horizon 2020 participation and research on resilient electrical nanogrids. This award is a separate project-director appointment from the senior-researcher role in ELECTRON.
contributions: Directed research activities and project management.
Managed the competitively awarded national participation-support project.
details: The budget shown belongs to this national award, not the full ELECTRON consortium.

name: ELECTRON
title: rEsilient and seLf-healed EleCTRical pOwer Nanogrid
institution: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest
summary: Cybersecurity, resilience and recovery for electrical power and energy systems.
description: ELECTRON developed an integrated approach to protecting electrical power and energy systems against cyber, privacy and data attacks. Its four pillars cover risk assessment and certification, anomaly detection and prevention, failure mitigation and energy restoration, and AR/VR-based personnel training.
contributions: Contributed as a senior researcher within the POLITEHNICA Bucharest team.
details: Topic: SU-DS04-2018-2020 — cybersecurity in electrical power and energy systems.

name: STOCMAN
title: Intelligent Management System for Improving the Efficiency of Battery Storage Systems based on Pb-acid and Li-Ion Batteries
funding: POC · Priority Axis 1 · Action 1.2.1 · Innovation of Products and Services in an Innovative Start-Up
summary: Intelligent management for more efficient lead-acid and lithium-ion battery storage.
description: STOCMAN focused on an intelligent management system for battery-based energy storage, covering both lead-acid and lithium-ion technologies within the innovative start-up funding programme.
contributions: Managed the research and development project within the POC funding framework.
details: Host company: SC ADEMA EQUIP SRL.

name: LargCoat
title: Innovative Technologies for Physical Vapor Deposition Based on Thin, Multifunctional, Nanostructured Layers for Large Components
summary: Research participation in large-component physical-vapour-deposition technologies.
description: The project investigated physical vapour deposition technologies using thin, multifunctional, nanostructured layers for large components.
contributions: Performed research activities as a member of the Politehnica University of Bucharest team.

name: FARCROSS
title: FAcilitating Regional CROSS-border Electricity Transmission through Innovation
summary: Improving cross-border electricity flows, grid observability and regional coordination.
description: FARCROSS brought together energy-system stakeholders to demonstrate hardware and software that increase the use of transmission assets and support regional cooperation. Its scope includes dynamic line rating, wide-area protection, renewable-generation forecasting, reserve optimisation and regulatory barriers to cross-border flows.
contributions: Performed research activities as a research assistant at Politehnica University of Bucharest.
details: Topic: LC-SC3-ES-2-2019 — regional cross-border cooperation in transmission grids.
The funding amounts represent the entire consortium.

name: FLEXITRANSTORE
title: An Integrated Platform for Increased Flexibility in Smart Transmission Grids with Storage Entities and Large Penetration of Renewable Energy Sources
summary: Storage, demand response and flexibility markets for renewable-rich transmission networks.
description: FLEXITRANSTORE developed a flexible energy-grid platform combining storage, demand response, control improvements and electricity-market mechanisms. Eight demonstrations across six countries addressed renewable integration, cross-border electricity exchange and more effective use of existing grid infrastructure.
contributions: Contributed research as a member of the Politehnica University of Bucharest team.
details: Demonstration countries: Greece, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Slovenia, Belgium and Spain.
The consortium duration and budget are separate from the individual appointment.

name: Electromagnetic launcher
title: Electromagnetic Launcher for Extinguishing Violent Fires in Drilling Operations and Launching Drones for Investigations or Interventions
summary: Research on electromagnetic launch systems for emergency intervention and investigation.
description: A research assignment concerning electromagnetic launching for intervention in drilling-operation fires and the deployment of investigation or intervention drones.
contributions: Contributed to the project as a research assistant at Politehnica University of Bucharest.

name: Electrical-network monitoring
title: Integrated Monitoring and Control System for Real-Time Complete Estimation of the Functional State of Electrical Network Assemblies
summary: Real-time monitoring, control and functional-state estimation of electrical network assemblies.
description: An integrated-system research assignment focused on monitoring and control for the real-time estimation of the operating state of electrical-network assemblies.
contributions: Contributed to the project as a research assistant at Politehnica University of Bucharest.

name: 3D dental e-learning
title: Virtual E-Learning Platform Based on 3D Applications for Use in Dental Prosthetics
summary: A virtual learning platform using three-dimensional applications in dental prosthetics.
description: A research assignment on a virtual e-learning platform for dental prosthetics, using three-dimensional applications to support training.
contributions: Contributed to the project as a research assistant at Politehnica University of Bucharest.
